issue.title: Add support for superseding in CancellableSingleObjectCache

labels.name: :Distributed/Distributed
labels.description: A catch all label for anything in the Distributed Area. Please avoid if you can.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Today each retrieval from a `CancellableSingleObjectCache` triggers a
corresponding refresh. This results in unnecessary work in the case that
a fresher input became available while the refresh was waiting in a
queue somewhere. With this commit we make it possible for an async
refresh implementation to check whether there's been a fresher input
since it was enqueued and, if so, to wait for the fresher refresh to
complete instead.

It also fixes a small bug that held an extra reference to the cached
item while triggering the refresh, which prevented synchronous refreshes
from ever being cancelled.

issue.title: Autoscaling capacity off transport thread

labels.name: :Distributed/Autoscaling
labels.description: Automatically adding or removing nodes in a cluster

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Calculating the autoscaling capacity can take considerable time and
has therefore been moved off transport threads. Also, we ensure that
only one thread calculates capacity and only compute one result if
multiple requests are pending, serving all pending requests in one go.
Finally, the capacity requests are now cancellable.

Closes #79104
